title: General aspects and iDrive options
summary: Feedback on general aspects of the F70 is mostly favorable, with broad praise alongside isolated criticism about iDrive options and one ambiguously coded comment that reads positive in wording.

positive.summary: Positive reviews give broad approval of the car overall and say all aspects are excellent or satisfying.

negative.summary: The negative-coded example says earlier irritating aspects were removed and presents this as an improvement, so the available negative evidence is limited and internally contradictory.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention wanting some iDrive options to be different and noticing few negative aspects, but the examples are too ambiguous to classify more specifically.

limitations: The topic is broad and somewhat diffuse, combining overall impressions with a specific comment about iDrive options.
One negative-coded fragment reads as praise for improvements, so sentiment interpretation is uncertain for that example.
The sample is very small, and two of the five examples are undetermined.
